name: Emby
description: Playback observations and daily movie suggestions from your Emby library

settings.label: Server URL
settings.help: Private IPv4 or loopback address with explicit port, for example http://192.168.0.10:8096. HTTPS requires a trusted certificate. No discovery or redirects.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: Paste only the dedicated API key value from the Emby dashboard. Used in read-only request headers; never sent to Cards, Tasks or links.

settings.label: Polling interval
settings.help: Checks playback observations and cached daily library picks. Library metadata has its own slower refresh interval.

settings.label: Monitor playback sessions
settings.help: Enable playback readings and Events. Turn off for library suggestions only; no playback Events are emitted while off.

settings.label: Library movie suggestions
settings.help: Read recent movie metadata from your configured Emby server. Suggestions rotate by date and make no playback changes. Watched status is not filtered.

settings.label: Library metadata refresh
settings.help: Defaults to 6 hours. The Library tab also has an explicit Refresh library button.

settings.label: Recent movies to consider
settings.help: One bounded request reads the most recently added movies. This is a selection window, not a complete-library scan.

settings.label: Preferred library genres
settings.help: Daily suggestions can match any selected genre. All genres removes the filter.

actions.name: Refresh Emby readings
actions.description: Check enabled playback observations and due movie-library metadata. Does not control playback.

actions.name: Refresh movie library
actions.description: Read a bounded selection of movie metadata. Does not read sessions or change playback.

events.name: Emby reading updated
events.description: A successful session read, including no sessions.

events.name: Playback started
events.description: A newly observed playback change between recent successful reads. First reads/restarts baseline; no replay.

events.name: Playback paused
events.description: A newly observed playback change between recent successful reads. First reads/restarts baseline; no replay.

events.name: Playback resumed
events.description: A newly observed playback change between recent successful reads. First reads/restarts baseline; no replay.

events.name: Playback stopped
events.description: Previously reported media is now explicitly idle. Missing sessions/data do not prove a stop.

sections.title: Connect your server
steps: Enter your private server URL and dedicated Emby API key. Enable Emby when configured. The same connection supplies both playback observations and movie metadata.
For daily recommendations, turn on Library movie suggestions. Choose the recent-movie window, metadata refresh interval and any preferred genres.
Monitor playback sessions is independent. Leave it off if you only want library suggestions; playback Events stay silent.

sections.title: Choose a film
steps: Library shows four daily picks from the cached recent-movie selection. Watched status is not filtered. No playback command is sent.
Refresh library makes one explicit metadata request, subject to a short cooldown and provider failure backoff. Source failures retain same-server cached metadata.
Create a From your Emby library Card, enable it and add it to Today or any Vista. A Fullscreen design is available. Movie links open Emby, which handles its own sign-in and playback.
